title: Rediscover Vietnam Complete Tour
alt: Sampan boats among the coconut palms of the Mekong Delta
transport: Two domestic flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Hanoi and Ninh Binh
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small boutique hotel in the old quarter

activities.name: Ninh Binh day tour
activities.description: South to Ninh Binh for a rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc and the limestone country around it.

activities.name: Cycle ride to Bich Dong pagoda
activities.description: A private cycle ride through the rice fields to Bich Dong, a three tier pagoda built into the rock face.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: Two nights in the old quarter, with a full day south to Ninh Binh and a cycle ride to Bich Dong.

stops.name: Halong Bay
stops.accom: 1 night · All meals · Cabin with a window · 3★ · Timber cruise boat moored among the karsts overnight

activities.name: Halong Bay overnight cruise
activities.description: A shared cruise out among the limestone islands, with lunch and dinner on board and a night moored in a quiet bay.

program.name: Halong Bay
program.description: A night on the water among the limestone islands, with all meals served on board.

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Da Nang and Ba Na Hills
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel a few streets back from My Khe beach

activities.name: Surprise Cave on Bo Hon island
activities.description: A morning climb into the Surprise Cave, three great chambers of stalactites above the water, before the boat turns back.

activities.name: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
activities.match: Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge Day Tour
activities.description: The long cable car up to Ba Na, the Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands, and the French village and gardens at the top.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: The flight to the central coast for two nights near the beach, with a full day up at Ba Na Hills.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.subtitle: Saigon, the Mekong and Cu Chi
stops.hotel: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel in District 1, a short walk from the opera house

activities.name: Mekong Delta day tour
activities.description: South to My Tho for a boat into the coconut creeks, a sampan through the palms, and the workshops where they make coconut candy.

activities.name: Cu Chi tunnels half day tour
activities.match: Cu Chi Tunnel Half Day Tour
activities.description: The tunnel network north west of the city, with the trapdoors, the kitchens and a crawl through a widened section of the original shafts.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: Three nights in District 1, with a full day in the Mekong Delta and the Cu Chi tunnels after.

1: Arrival at Noi Bai airport and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your hotel in the old quarter
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: an evening walk around Hoan Kiem lake
2: Breakfast, then south towards Ninh Binh
A rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc
A private cycle ride through the rice fields
Bich Dong, a pagoda built into the rock
3: Breakfast and check out, then east towards the coast
Board your cruise boat in the early afternoon
A night moored among the limestone islands
4: Breakfast on board, then the climb into the Surprise Cave
Back to the pier and on to Hanoi airport
Check in near the beach, evening free
5: Breakfast, then the cable car up to Ba Na
The Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands
The French village and the gardens at the top
Back down to Da Nang in the evening
6: Breakfast and check out, then the flight south
Rest of the day free in the city
Optional: the rooftop bars on Nguyen Hue
7: Breakfast, then south into the delta
A boat through the coconut creeks at My Tho
A sampan ride under the palms
The coconut candy workshops, then back to the city
8: Breakfast, then north west to Cu Chi
The tunnels, the trapdoors and the kitchens
A crawl through a widened section of the shafts
9: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Tan Son Nhat for your flight home

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Nine days, all three regions and nothing rushed. Two flights save you three days of driving.
expert.tip: Put Cu Chi after the delta day as it is scheduled here. The tunnels are better understood once you have seen the country they run under.

summary: Nine days end to end: two nights in Hanoi with Ninh Binh and a Bich Dong cycle ride, an overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave, two nights in Da Nang for Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge, then three in Saigon with the Mekong Delta and the Cu Chi tunnels.
included: Included: 8 nights with breakfast daily, dinner at the northern and central hotels and all meals on the cruise boat; two domestic flights; private transfers throughout; a Ninh Binh day tour; a private cycle ride to Bich Dong; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave; a full day up at Ba Na with the Golden Bridge; a Mekong Delta day tour; the Cu Chi tunnels half day tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches other than on the cruise; travel insurance; personal expenses.
